skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the characteristics and functions of land, and the methods and principles of state land management to solve land management issues.
Apply knowledge of land policies and laws to explain land management and use scenarios.
Analyze situations and policies to make decisions.
Work individually and in groups to choose policies and solve land management issues.
Understand the legal framework and policies related to land management.
Understand the organizational structure, division of responsibilities, and functions within the land management system.
Apply research methods to analyze land management policies and situations.
Analyze and synthesize information to understand land management issues.
Effectively present research findings and analysis.

prerequisite_courses: Research Methods in Economics and Society
